CREATE TABLE entries (
 namespace_uuid TEXT NOT NULL, scan_uuid TEXT NOT NULL, relative_path BLOB NOT NULL,
 kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('file','directory','symlink','special','unknown')),
 size INTEGER CHECK(size IS NULL OR size >= 0),
 mtime_ns TEXT, birthtime_ns TEXT, ctime_ns TEXT,
 attributes INTEGER, mode INTEGER,
 sha256 TEXT CHECK(sha256 IS NULL OR (length(CAST(sha256 AS BLOB))=64 AND instr(sha256,char(0))=0 AND sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')),
 hash_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(hash_status IN ('complete','changed','not-applicable','error')),
 error TEXT, link_target BLOB, observed_us INTEGER CHECK(observed_us IS NULL OR observed_us > 0),
 CHECK((hash_status='complete' AND sha256 IS NOT NULL AND kind='file') OR (hash_status!='complete' AND sha256 IS NULL)),
 CHECK((kind='file' AND size IS NOT NULL AND hash_status IN ('complete','changed','error')) OR (kind!='file' AND hash_status='not-applicable')),
 CHECK(hash_status NOT IN ('changed','error') OR error IS NOT NULL),
 PRIMARY KEY(namespace_uuid,scan_uuid,relative_path),
 FOREIGN KEY(namespace_uuid,scan_uuid) REFERENCES scans(namespace_uuid,scan_uuid)
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE coverage_scopes(
 owner_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(owner_kind IN('repository','source','source_inventory','resource','collection','field')),
 owner_coordinates_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(p1_json(owner_coordinates_json)),
 repository_uuidv4 TEXT REFERENCES repository_context,
 source_registration_uuidv4 TEXT REFERENCES sources,
 source_scope_json TEXT CHECK(source_scope_json IS NULL OR p1_json(source_scope_json)),
 service_instance_uuidv4 TEXT,
 resource_kind TEXT,
 provider_resource_id TEXT,
 collection_kind TEXT,
 collection_provenance_json TEXT,
 field_name TEXT,
 coverage_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(coverage_kind)>0),
 PRIMARY KEY(owner_kind,owner_coordinates_json),
 FOREIGN KEY(source_registration_uuidv4,repository_uuidv4) REFERENCES source_repositories,
 FOREIGN KEY(service_instance_uuidv4,resource_kind,provider_resource_id) REFERENCES resources,
 FOREIGN KEY(service_instance_uuidv4,resource_kind,provider_resource_id,collection_kind,collection_provenance_json) REFERENCES collections,
 CHECK(CASE owner_kind
 WHEN 'repository' THEN source_scope_json IS NULL AND repository_uuidv4 IS NOT NULL AND source_registration_uuidv4 IS NULL AND service_instance_uuidv4 IS NULL AND resource_kind IS NULL AND provider_resource_id IS NULL AND collection_kind IS NULL AND collection_provenance_json IS NULL AND field_name IS NULL AND owner_coordinates_json=p1_array(repository_uuidv4,coverage_kind)
 WHEN 'source' THEN source_scope_json IS NULL AND repository_uuidv4 IS NOT NULL AND source_registration_uuidv4 IS NOT NULL AND service_instance_uuidv4 IS NULL AND resource_kind IS NULL AND provider_resource_id IS NULL AND collection_kind IS NULL AND collection_provenance_json IS NULL AND field_name IS NULL AND owner_coordinates_json=p1_array(source_registration_uuidv4,repository_uuidv4,coverage_kind)
 WHEN 'resource' THEN source_scope_json IS NULL AND repository_uuidv4 IS NULL AND source_registration_uuidv4 IS NULL AND service_instance_uuidv4 IS NOT NULL AND resource_kind IS NOT NULL AND provider_resource_id IS NOT NULL AND collection_kind IS NULL AND collection_provenance_json IS NULL AND field_name IS NULL AND owner_coordinates_json=p1_array(service_instance_uuidv4,resource_kind,provider_resource_id,coverage_kind)
 WHEN 'collection' THEN source_scope_json IS NULL AND repository_uuidv4 IS NULL AND source_registration_uuidv4 IS NULL AND service_instance_uuidv4 IS NOT NULL AND resource_kind IS NOT NULL AND provider_resource_id IS NOT NULL AND collection_kind IS NOT NULL AND collection_provenance_json IS NOT NULL AND field_name IS NULL AND owner_coordinates_json=p1_array(service_instance_uuidv4,resource_kind,provider_resource_id,collection_kind,collection_provenance_json,coverage_kind)
 WHEN 'field' THEN source_scope_json IS NULL AND repository_uuidv4 IS NULL AND source_registration_uuidv4 IS NULL AND service_instance_uuidv4 IS NOT NULL AND resource_kind IS NOT NULL AND provider_resource_id IS NOT NULL AND collection_kind IS NULL AND collection_provenance_json IS NULL AND field_name IS NOT NULL AND length(field_name)>0 AND owner_coordinates_json=p1_array(service_instance_uuidv4,resource_kind,provider_resource_id,field_name,coverage_kind)
 WHEN 'source_inventory' THEN repository_uuidv4 IS NULL AND source_registration_uuidv4 IS NOT NULL AND source_scope_json IS NOT NULL AND service_instance_uuidv4 IS NULL AND resource_kind IS NULL AND provider_resource_id IS NULL AND collection_kind IS NULL AND collection_provenance_json IS NULL AND field_name IS NULL AND owner_coordinates_json=p1_array(source_registration_uuidv4,source_scope_json,coverage_kind)
 ELSE 0 END)
) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE field_candidates(
 service_instance_uuidv4 TEXT NOT NULL,
 resource_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
 provider_resource_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 field_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(field_name)>0),
 value_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(p1_json(value_json)),
 clock_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(p1_json(clock_json) AND json_type(clock_json)='object'
   AND COALESCE(json_type(clock_json,'$.domain')='text',0) AND length(json_extract(clock_json,'$.domain'))>0
   AND COALESCE(json_type(clock_json,'$.at_us') IN('integer','null'),0) AND typeof(json_extract(clock_json,'$.at_us')) IN('integer','null') AND (json_type(clock_json,'$.at_us')='null' OR json_extract(clock_json,'$.at_us')>0) AND json_remove(clock_json,'$.domain','$.at_us')='{}'),
 provenance_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(p1_json(provenance_json) AND json_type(provenance_json)='object' AND COALESCE(json_type(provenance_json,'$.source')='text',0) AND length(json_extract(provenance_json,'$.source'))>0 AND json_type(provenance_json,'$.evidence') IS NOT NULL AND json_type(provenance_json,'$.evidence')!='null'),
 observed_at_us INTEGER CHECK(observed_at_us IS NULL OR (typeof(observed_at_us)='integer' AND observed_at_us>0)),
 clock_domain TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS(json_extract(clock_json,'$.domain')) VIRTUAL,
 source_clock_us INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS(json_extract(clock_json,'$.at_us')) VIRTUAL,
 text_body_sha256 TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS(CASE WHEN field_name='text_body_sha256' THEN json_extract(value_json,'$') END) VIRTUAL REFERENCES text_bodies(sha256),
 CHECK(field_name!='text_body_sha256' OR json_type(value_json)='null' OR (json_type(value_json)='text' AND length(json_extract(value_json,'$'))=64 AND json_extract(value_json,'$') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')),
 CHECK(field_name!='repository_uuidv4'),
 PRIMARY KEY(service_instance_uuidv4,resource_kind,provider_resource_id,field_name,clock_json,value_json,provenance_json),
 FOREIGN KEY(service_instance_uuidv4,resource_kind,provider_resource_id) REFERENCES resources
) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE resource_relations(
 service_instance_uuidv4 TEXT NOT NULL,
 resource_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
 provider_resource_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 relation_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(relation_kind)>0),
 members_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(p1_json(members_json) AND json_type(members_json)='array'),
 provenance_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(p1_json(provenance_json) AND json_type(provenance_json)='object' AND COALESCE(json_type(provenance_json,'$.source')='text',0) AND length(json_extract(provenance_json,'$.source'))>0 AND json_type(provenance_json,'$.evidence') IS NOT NULL AND json_type(provenance_json,'$.evidence')!='null'),
 scope_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(p1_json(scope_json)),
 observed_at_us INTEGER CHECK(observed_at_us IS NULL OR (typeof(observed_at_us)='integer' AND observed_at_us>0)),
 -- Read-only projections of the original singleton report; never another authority.
 parent_service TEXT COLLATE BINARY GENERATED ALWAYS AS(CASE WHEN relation_kind='parent' THEN json_extract(members_json,'$[0][0]') END) VIRTUAL,
 parent_kind TEXT COLLATE BINARY GENERATED ALWAYS AS(CASE WHEN relation_kind='parent' THEN json_extract(members_json,'$[0][1]') END) VIRTUAL,
 parent_id TEXT COLLATE BINARY GENERATED ALWAYS AS(CASE WHEN relation_kind='parent' THEN json_extract(members_json,'$[0][2]') END) VIRTUAL,
 source_document_kind TEXT COLLATE BINARY GENERATED ALWAYS AS(CASE WHEN relation_kind='parent' THEN coalesce(json_extract(scope_json,'$.document_kind'),'') END) VIRTUAL,
 report_clock_json TEXT COLLATE BINARY GENERATED ALWAYS AS(CASE WHEN relation_kind IN('parent','transfer_event_report') THEN json_extract(scope_json,'$.clock') END) VIRTUAL,
 -- I4: generated only from the original Event support payload.
 event_support_members_json TEXT COLLATE BINARY GENERATED ALWAYS AS(CASE WHEN relation_kind='transfer_event_report' THEN p1_transfer_value_v1(scope_json,'parent_members_json') END) VIRTUAL,
 event_support_provenance_json TEXT COLLATE BINARY GENERATED ALWAYS AS(CASE WHEN relation_kind='transfer_event_report' THEN p1_transfer_value_v1(scope_json,'parent_provenance_json') END) VIRTUAL,
 event_support_scope_json TEXT COLLATE BINARY GENERATED ALWAYS AS(CASE WHEN relation_kind='transfer_event_report' THEN p1_transfer_value_v1(scope_json,'parent_scope_json') END) VIRTUAL,
 event_support_service TEXT COLLATE BINARY GENERATED ALWAYS AS(CASE WHEN relation_kind='transfer_event_report' THEN p1_transfer_value_v1(scope_json,'parent_service') END) VIRTUAL,
 event_support_kind TEXT COLLATE BINARY GENERATED ALWAYS AS(CASE WHEN relation_kind='transfer_event_report' THEN p1_transfer_value_v1(scope_json,'parent_kind') END) VIRTUAL,
 event_support_id TEXT COLLATE BINARY GENERATED ALWAYS AS(CASE WHEN relation_kind='transfer_event_report' THEN p1_transfer_value_v1(scope_json,'parent_id') END) VIRTUAL,
 event_support_relation_kind TEXT COLLATE BINARY GENERATED ALWAYS AS(CASE WHEN relation_kind='transfer_event_report' THEN 'parent' END) VIRTUAL,
 event_document_kind TEXT COLLATE BINARY GENERATED ALWAYS AS(CASE WHEN relation_kind='transfer_event_report' THEN 'timeline_event' END) VIRTUAL,
 CHECK(relation_kind!='transfer_event_report' OR (p1_transfer_event_v1(service_instance_uuidv4,resource_kind,provider_resource_id,members_json,provenance_json,scope_json,observed_at_us)=1
 AND report_clock_json IS NOT NULL AND event_support_members_json IS NOT NULL
 AND event_support_provenance_json IS NOT NULL AND event_support_scope_json IS NOT NULL
 AND event_support_service IS NOT NULL AND event_support_kind IS NOT NULL AND event_support_id IS NOT NULL
 AND event_support_service=service_instance_uuidv4 COLLATE BINARY AND event_support_kind='issue' COLLATE BINARY)),
 CHECK(relation_kind!='parent' OR p1_parent_report_v1(service_instance_uuidv4,resource_kind,provider_resource_id,members_json,provenance_json,scope_json,observed_at_us)=1),
 CHECK(relation_kind!='parent' OR (parent_service IS NOT NULL AND parent_kind IS NOT NULL AND parent_id IS NOT NULL AND source_document_kind IS NOT NULL AND report_clock_json IS NOT NULL)),
 PRIMARY KEY(service_instance_uuidv4,resource_kind,provider_resource_id,relation_kind,members_json,provenance_json,scope_json),
 FOREIGN KEY(service_instance_uuidv4,resource_kind,provider_resource_id) REFERENCES resources,
 FOREIGN KEY(parent_service,parent_kind,parent_id) REFERENCES resources,
 FOREIGN KEY(service_instance_uuidv4,resource_kind,provider_resource_id,source_document_kind)
 REFERENCES resources(service_instance_uuidv4,resource_kind,provider_resource_id,reference_document_kind),
 -- Complete ParentReportKey plus its actual generated subtype/kind.
 FOREIGN KEY(service_instance_uuidv4,resource_kind,provider_resource_id,event_support_relation_kind,event_support_members_json,event_support_provenance_json,event_support_scope_json,event_document_kind,event_support_kind)
 REFERENCES resource_relations(service_instance_uuidv4,resource_kind,provider_resource_id,relation_kind,members_json,provenance_json,scope_json,source_document_kind,parent_kind),
 -- Additional G3=A binding: the reported Issue must be this E's native Issue.
 FOREIGN KEY(service_instance_uuidv4,resource_kind,provider_resource_id,event_document_kind,event_support_kind,event_support_id)
 REFERENCES resources(service_instance_uuidv4,resource_kind,provider_resource_id,reference_document_kind,identifier_namespace_kind,identifier_namespace_id)
) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE resource_repository_relations(
 service_instance_uuidv4 TEXT NOT NULL,
 resource_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
 provider_resource_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 relation_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
 target_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(p1_mapping_target(target_json)=1),
 clock_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(p1_mapping_clock(clock_json)=1),
 provenance_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(p1_mapping_provenance(provenance_json)=1),
 observed_at_us INTEGER CHECK(observed_at_us IS NULL OR (typeof(observed_at_us)='integer' AND observed_at_us>0)),
 repository_uuidv4 TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS(CASE WHEN json_type(target_json)='text' THEN json_extract(target_json,'$') END) VIRTUAL REFERENCES repository_context(repository_uuidv4),
 clock_domain TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS(json_extract(clock_json,'$.domain')) VIRTUAL,
 source_clock_us INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS(json_extract(clock_json,'$.at_us')) VIRTUAL,
 -- Complete original Event report reference; non-Transfer roles keep SQL NULL.
 event_report_members_json TEXT COLLATE BINARY,
 event_report_scope_json TEXT COLLATE BINARY,
 event_report_kind TEXT COLLATE BINARY GENERATED ALWAYS AS(CASE WHEN relation_kind IN('transfer_from_repository','transfer_to_repository') THEN 'transfer_event_report' END) VIRTUAL,
 event_document_kind TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS(CASE WHEN relation_kind IN('transfer_from_repository','transfer_to_repository') THEN 'timeline_event' END) VIRTUAL,
 event_parent_resource_kind TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS(CASE WHEN relation_kind IN('transfer_from_repository','transfer_to_repository') THEN 'issue' END) VIRTUAL,
 CHECK(CASE WHEN relation_kind IN('transfer_from_repository','transfer_to_repository') THEN
 event_report_members_json IS NOT NULL AND event_report_scope_json IS NOT NULL
 AND p1_transfer_endpoint_v1(relation_kind,target_json,event_report_scope_json,clock_json)=1
 ELSE event_report_members_json IS NULL AND event_report_scope_json IS NULL END),
 CHECK(typeof(source_clock_us) IN('integer','null')),
 CHECK((relation_kind='represents_repository' AND resource_kind='repository') OR (relation_kind='owning_repository' AND resource_kind='issue') OR (relation_kind IN('base_repository','head_repository') AND resource_kind='pull_request') OR (relation_kind IN('transfer_from_repository','transfer_to_repository') AND resource_kind='comment')),
 CHECK(relation_kind!='represents_repository' OR json_type(target_json)='text'),
 PRIMARY KEY(service_instance_uuidv4,resource_kind,provider_resource_id,relation_kind,clock_json,target_json,provenance_json),
 FOREIGN KEY(service_instance_uuidv4,resource_kind,provider_resource_id) REFERENCES resources(service_instance_uuidv4,resource_kind,provider_resource_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(service_instance_uuidv4,resource_kind,provider_resource_id,event_document_kind,event_parent_resource_kind) REFERENCES resources(service_instance_uuidv4,resource_kind,provider_resource_id,reference_document_kind,identifier_namespace_kind),
 FOREIGN KEY(service_instance_uuidv4,resource_kind,provider_resource_id,event_report_kind,event_report_members_json,provenance_json,event_report_scope_json)
 REFERENCES resource_relations(service_instance_uuidv4,resource_kind,provider_resource_id,relation_kind,members_json,provenance_json,scope_json)
) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE resources(
 service_instance_uuidv4 TEXT COLLATE BINARY NOT NULL REFERENCES providers
   CHECK(p1_uuid4(service_instance_uuidv4)=1),
 resource_kind TEXT COLLATE BINARY NOT NULL CHECK(resource_kind!=''),

   CHECK(typeof(provider_resource_id)='text' AND p1_resource_identity_v1(provider_resource_id)=1),

   GENERATED ALWAYS AS(coalesce(document_kind,'')) VIRTUAL,

CREATE TRIGGER source_inventory_provider_members BEFORE INSERT ON source_inventory_evidence BEGIN
 SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM json_each(NEW.provider_repositories_json) member
  WHERE CASE WHEN member.type='array' THEN
   json_array_length(member.value)!=3
   OR json_type(member.value,'$[0]') IS NOT 'text'
   OR json_type(member.value,'$[1]') IS NOT 'text'
   OR json_type(member.value,'$[2]') IS NOT 'text'
   OR json_extract(member.value,'$[1]')!='repository'
   OR json_extract(member.value,'$[0]')!=(SELECT service_instance_uuidv4 FROM sources WHERE source_registration_uuidv4=NEW.source_registration_uuidv4)
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM resources resource
    WHERE resource.service_instance_uuidv4=json_extract(member.value,'$[0]')
     AND resource.resource_kind='repository'
     AND resource.provider_resource_id=json_extract(member.value,'$[2]')
     AND resource.identifier_namespace_kind IS NULL AND resource.document_kind IS NULL)
  ELSE 1 END)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(NEW.provider_repositories_json) member
   GROUP BY CASE WHEN member.type='array' THEN json_extract(member.value,'$[0]') END,
    CASE WHEN member.type='array' THEN json_extract(member.value,'$[1]') END,
    CASE WHEN member.type='array' THEN json_extract(member.value,'$[2]') END HAVING count(*)>1)
 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'invalid Source Provider repository membership') END;
END

 presence_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(presence_state IN ('present','absent')),
 ref_form TEXT CHECK(ref_form IS NULL OR ref_form IN ('direct','symbolic')),
 direct_format TEXT, direct_target_object_oid TEXT, symbolic_target_ref_name BLOB,
 resolved_format TEXT, resolved_target_object_oid TEXT, peeled_format TEXT, peeled_target_object_oid TEXT,
 root_format TEXT, root_object_oid TEXT, absence_evidence TEXT,
 CHECK((direct_format IS NULL AND direct_target_object_oid IS NULL) OR (direct_format IS NOT NULL AND direct_target_object_oid IS NOT NULL AND p1_object_oid(direct_format,direct_target_object_oid))),
 CHECK((resolved_format IS NULL AND resolved_target_object_oid IS NULL) OR (resolved_format IS NOT NULL AND resolved_target_object_oid IS NOT NULL AND p1_object_oid(resolved_format,resolved_target_object_oid))),
 CHECK((peeled_format IS NULL AND peeled_target_object_oid IS NULL) OR (peeled_format IS NOT NULL AND peeled_target_object_oid IS NOT NULL AND p1_object_oid(peeled_format,peeled_target_object_oid))),
 CHECK((root_format IS NULL AND root_object_oid IS NULL) OR (root_format IS NOT NULL AND root_object_oid IS NOT NULL AND p1_object_oid(root_format,root_object_oid))),
 CHECK(symbolic_target_ref_name IS NULL OR (substr(symbolic_target_ref_name,1,5)=X'726566732F' AND instr(symbolic_target_ref_name,X'00')=0)),
 CHECK(direct_target_object_oid IS NULL OR ref_form IS 'direct'),
 CHECK(symbolic_target_ref_name IS NULL OR ref_form IS 'symbolic'),
 CHECK(p1_ref_result_formats(direct_format,resolved_format,peeled_format,root_format)),
 CHECK((presence_state='present' AND absence_evidence IS NULL) OR
       (presence_state='absent' AND p1_ref_absence(absence_evidence) AND ref_form IS NULL AND direct_target_object_oid IS NULL AND symbolic_target_ref_name IS NULL AND resolved_target_object_oid IS NULL AND peeled_target_object_oid IS NULL AND root_object_oid IS NULL)),
 PRIMARY KEY(observation_origin_uuidv4,ref_observation_uuidv7,provenance),
 UNIQUE(observation_origin_uuidv4,ref_observation_uuidv7,provenance,root_format,root_object_oid),
 FOREIGN KEY(observation_origin_uuidv4,ref_observation_uuidv7) REFERENCES ref_observations,
 FOREIGN KEY(direct_format,direct_target_object_oid) REFERENCES git_objects,
 FOREIGN KEY(resolved_format,resolved_target_object_oid) REFERENCES git_objects,
 FOREIGN KEY(peeled_format,peeled_target_object_oid) REFERENCES git_objects,
 FOREIGN KEY(root_format,root_object_oid) REFERENCES git_objects
) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID

ref_absence_subject.name: ref_absence_subject
ref_absence_subject.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER ref_absence_subject BEFORE INSERT ON ref_observation_claims
WHEN NEW.presence_state='absent' AND NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM ref_observations o WHERE o.observation_origin_uuidv4=NEW.observation_origin_uuidv4
 AND o.ref_observation_uuidv7=NEW.ref_observation_uuidv7
 AND json_extract(NEW.absence_evidence,'$[0]')=o.source_attribution
 AND json_extract(NEW.absence_evidence,'$[1]')=o.visibility_scope
 AND json_extract(NEW.absence_evidence,'$[2]')=lower(hex(o.ref_name_bytes)))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'absence evidence must match observed source, visibility and ref'); END

finite_settlement.name: finite_settlement
finite_settlement.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER finite_settlement BEFORE UPDATE OF actual ON work_accounting BEGIN
 SELECT CASE WHEN coalesce(NEW.actual,NEW.reserved)-coalesce(OLD.actual,OLD.reserved) >
 (SELECT finite_limit-spent_or_reserved FROM request_budgets WHERE request_origin_uuidv4=NEW.request_origin_uuidv4 AND request_uuidv4=NEW.request_uuidv4 AND work_kind=NEW.work_kind)
 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'finite cumulative request budget') END;
END

 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'finite cumulative request budget') END;
